scope: Benchmark-only bounded legal/material adjudication, not whole-game proof or accuracy. Relocated boards are counterfactual positions, not legal variations.

motifs.label: Removing the Defender
motifs.evidence: Qxd6 removes the queen on d6 that defended the knight on e5. After Rxd6, Bxe5 collects that unguarded target. Declining permits connected captures or safe retention instead; it does not force that same continuation. Every legal reply is checked, including other losses and immediate counterchecks. The 3.2-pawn bound is local material, not a full-position evaluation.

timeline.evidence: Bxe5 answers Rxd6, preserving the gain from Qxd6. These exchanged pieces are already included in that capture's value.
